calendarCopy.title: Prepare an appointment from a copy
calendarCopy.previewNotice: Review this text before adopting it. No appointment has been prepared or sent yet.
calendarCopy.independent: Independent copy adopted: later conversation changes will not update it. Closing, switching conversations or reloading discards this local draft.
calendarCopy.exclusions: Text only: images and attachments are not included. Markup, links and instructions remain inert text. No document is read again.
calendarCopy.adopt: Use this copy as a draft
calendarCopy.manual: Fill in the fields yourself. Times use Paris (Europe/Paris), even when abroad. Calendar conflicts have not been checked.
calendarCopy.dateFormat: Time format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (e.g. 2026-09-15T09:00). For the ambiguous hour when daylight saving ends, include the offset, for example 2026-10-25T02:30+02:00 or +01:00.
calendarCopy.pendingVerification: Verification of this response has not been confirmed as complete. This copy does not restart it: check the content yourself.
calendarCopy.selectionRequired: Select a passage in the source text first.
calendarCopy.notesLimit: These notes would exceed 8,192 characters. Select a shorter passage; no text has been truncated.
calendarCopy.reviewNotice: Only the fields below will be sent to the displayed account. Check the normalized Paris times and exact notes.
calendarCopy.dispatchNotice: After sending, closing this window does not delete an appointment already created at Google. If the result is uncertain, check your calendar before trying again.
calendarCopy.done: Creation confirmed by Google. The local draft has been cleared.

errors.unavailable: Copy unavailable in this context. Close this window and reopen the response from your loaded workspace.
errors.connection: Calendar needs an available Google connection. Close, connect or reconnect Google through Calendar on the home screen, then open a new copy.
errors.source: This response is not a usable completed text source.
errors.busy: The conversation or its verification is still running. Wait for it to finish, then open a new copy.
errors.changed: The context has changed. This copy and its confirmation are no longer usable; close this window and start again.
errors.state: This confirmation is no longer valid. Return to the draft or open a new copy.
errors.limit: The source exceeds this copy's limits (200,000 text characters and 100 references maximum). Nothing was truncated.

workspaceArchive.historicalMessage: Restored message: old buttons and links remain disabled. The original text is preserved for copying and export.
workspaceArchive.historicalPending: Unfinished historical fact-check — it has not been restarted.
workspaceArchive.title: Encrypted archive of this conversation
workspaceArchive.demoUnavailable: Encrypted archives are not available in preview mode. Use Arty with a real account, outside this demo session.
workspaceArchive.scope: Local copy of every currently accessible message in this conversation, including its stored attachments and images. Nothing is sent to Arty or an AI.
workspaceArchive.exclusions: This is not a full account backup: API keys, connections, settings, memory, quarantined unreadable data and external resources are excluded. Restore and sync are not available yet.
workspaceArchive.limits: Limits: 128 files, 10 MiB per object, 60 MiB of decrypted content (messages and files) and a 64 MiB archive. The conversation must be idle during capture. Exceeding a limit stops the operation; no partial export is created.
workspaceArchive.includeProject: Also include the currently associated project, with all source documents and their previously extracted text. This may include documents not used in this conversation.
workspaceArchive.counts: {{conversations}} conversation(s), {{messages}} message(s), {{files}} file(s), {{projects}} project(s), {{documents}} project document(s).
workspaceArchive.references: References preserved but not embedded: {{unavailableAssociatedProjects}} associated project(s), {{unavailableHistoricalSources}} historical source(s), {{unavailableCropSources}} crop source(s).
workspaceArchive.variants: Some historical metadata differs from the stored files. Both are preserved separately without correcting your data.
workspaceArchive.keepCode: Keep this code separate from the file in a safe place. Without it, Arty cannot open the archive or give you the code again. Anyone with both the file and code can read its contents.
workspaceArchive.agree: I have saved the code separately and understood this archive’s scope.
workspaceArchive.engaged: Download or share requested. This does not confirm the file was saved: locate it in your chosen destination and verify it below. A sharing service you choose may receive the encrypted file.
workspaceArchive.verifyHelp: Choose an Arty archive saved on this device and enter its code. Verification stays local and does not change any conversation.
workspaceArchive.reselect: After saving, select the file yourself from this device and enter the separately saved code. We will check that it matches this capture exactly.
workspaceArchive.verifiedSame: File read back: it matches this capture exactly.
workspaceArchive.verifyScope: Verification checks encryption, structure and embedded files. It restores nothing, executes no content and does not guarantee message accuracy or the availability of external references.

errors.format: Unsupported format or incompatible data. No partial export or automatic correction was performed.
errors.limit: This archive or its contents exceeds a supported limit. No partial export was performed.
errors.integrity: Cannot open this archive: incorrect code or altered file. Check the code and selected file.
errors.secret: The recovery code is not in the expected format. Copy the complete code.
errors.cancelled: Operation cancelled: session or workspace unavailable. Reopen this window in your active session.
errors.missing: A required item is missing. A complete capture cannot be created.
errors.busy: This conversation still has work in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.unreadable: A stored item cannot be decrypted. A complete capture cannot be created.
errors.unavailable: The local workspace or download is unavailable. Check your session and try again.
errors.changed: Your workspace changed during the operation. Capture it again before downloading. An already saved file can still be verified.
errors.different: This is a valid archive, but it is not from this capture. Select the matching file or verify the other archive in settings.

erasureRecovery.idle: An already-started erasure needs to finish local cleanup before accounts can open. Recovery never sends another server deletion request and needs no sign-in.
erasureRecovery.uncertain: The server deletion response was not saved. Arty can consult its receipt without signing in. An unknown result will not trigger local cleanup or another deletion request.
erasureRecovery.not-sent: The deletion request was not sent. You can cancel this intent without erasing data, then reload. Nothing will be sent to the server here.
erasureRecovery.legacy-unknown: The outcome of this older request cannot be verified here. Keep storage intact to seek help, or explicitly choose erasure on this device only.
erasureRecovery.cancelled: The unsent request was cancelled without cleanup or server calls. Reload to open accounts.
erasureRecovery.localWarning: This erases this account’s declared local copies, not server data. Once finished, the secret for checking the old request is removed: its remote outcome may remain unknown. Other accounts are retained. This cannot be undone.
erasureRecovery.working: Checking the request and, if authorized, cleaning declared local copies…
erasureRecovery.failed: Verification or cleanup did not finish. No new server deletion request was sent. Keep storage and retry; if the issue persists, seek help. On Android, an application update may be required.
erasureRecovery.done: Cleanup of the declared local copies is verified. Reload to return to sign-in. A new local workspace can be created if this erasure has a compatible reset right; an older procedure does not create that right automatically.
erasureRecovery.disabled: This version cannot resume this cleanup yet. No private data is opened. A compatible version is required.

recovery.disabled: An interrupted migration is reported, but recovery is not enabled in this version. Keep site storage and install a compatible version. Reloading this same version will not resolve the situation.
recovery.idle: Your data and sign-in callback remain in place. Resuming migration may recreate copies and need more space; they will be verified before opening.
recovery.working: Local verification and recovery are in progress. Keep this window open.
recovery.failed: Recovery did not finish. Your data remains closed and no copy was deleted. Close other versions of Arty and check free storage before retrying. Changed data or a missing journal require dedicated recovery; do not clear storage.
recovery.done: Local migration is verified. Reload to open a new session on this storage.

migrationCancellation.inspect: Check whether this preparation can be abandoned
migrationCancellation.working: Inspecting the sources and preparation copies. Nothing is being changed.
migrationCancellation.consent: Only identified, verified preparation copies will be removed. Original conversations, files, projects, accounts and access will not be modified. This may free the space used by these copies, without guaranteeing enough capacity. This is not a restore or account deletion. Then reload to open a new session on the original storage.
migrationCancellation.initialInventory: No initial inventory was preserved. This confirmation applies only to the currently present sources just inspected, without guaranteeing that they match an earlier state.
migrationCancellation.confirmCta: Abandon this preparation, keep the sources
migrationCancellation.cancelling: Removing verified copies and stopping preparation. Keep this window open.
migrationCancellation.failed: Abandonment could not be confirmed. This path did not modify the sources; some preparation copies may already have been removed. Preserve storage and reload to inspect its current state. A more advanced migration cannot be abandoned here.
migrationCancellation.done: Preparation abandoned. Sources are preserved. Reload to open a new session on the original storage; no private session was opened here.

erasurePreparation.noAccount: No selectable account for this local erasure. Nothing was prepared or erased. Anonymous data is not supported by this path; reload to choose normal migration recovery.
erasurePreparation.inspect: Prepare copies before choosing local erasure
erasurePreparation.working: Inspecting current data and copies. Nothing is being written or erased.
erasurePreparation.confirm: Prepare local copies of every inventoried account?
erasurePreparation.consent: This step writes and verifies local copies. It may need additional space and does not free storage. No account will be erased or signed in. After reloading, you will separately choose the account to erase and confirm its local deletion.
erasurePreparation.initialInventory: No initial inventory was preserved. Preparation will use only the inventory of currently present data just inspected, without guaranteeing that it matches an earlier state.
erasurePreparation.preparing: Writing and verifying copies. No erasure. Keep this window open.
erasurePreparation.retry: Preparation was interrupted. Partial copies may remain. You can retry the same preparation; a persistent capacity shortage or a blocking older window must be resolved without purging data.
erasurePreparation.failed: Preparation cannot continue from this inventory. Preserve storage and reload to inspect its state again. No account deletion was performed.
erasurePreparation.done: Copies verified. Reload to choose an account to erase. No account was deleted and no private session was opened.

migrationErasure.inspect: Check whether an account can be erased locally
migrationErasure.working: Checking the sources and every copy. No data is being erased.
migrationErasure.choose: Choose the account to erase on this device. Names are only hints; also check the exact identifier shown.
migrationErasure.confirm: Confirm local erasure of this identifier?
migrationErasure.confirmBody: Irreversible: after recording and reloading, this account’s local conversations, files, projects, keys and sessions will be erased from this migration’s copies. Other accounts will be preserved. No deletion on the server or another device is requested or confirmed. This decision replaces migration recovery; it will not copy the account’s old data back.
migrationErasure.recording: Recording the local request. Keep this window open.
migrationErasure.recorded: Local request recorded. Reload to continue cleanup; the data has not been erased yet.
migrationErasure.failed: The request cannot be confirmed in this window. A copy changed or storage is inaccessible. Nothing was erased here. Reload to read the durable state: if the request was recorded, Arty will offer to continue its cleanup.
migrationErasure.incomplete: This erasure is unavailable in the current state: the destination or journal is incomplete, or its format is unsupported. Nothing was changed. Reload to choose migration recovery; if data keeps diverging, keep storage and contact support.

workspaceAdmission.checkingBody: Arty is checking whether your data can be opened. This check does not change your conversations or files.
workspaceAdmission.maintenanceBody: A local operation has not been closed. This version cannot resume it, so opening is stopped to preserve the data. Reload with a compatible version; do not clear site storage.
workspaceAdmission.incompatibleBody: This version of Arty cannot open the detected format. Use a compatible version of Arty, then reload. On Android, install the app update: reloading alone does not update the APK. Your data remains in place.
workspaceAdmission.corruptBody: The local control record is incomplete or inconsistent. Arty will not open the data or attempt an automatic repair. Your data remains in place.
workspaceAdmission.unavailableBody: Arty could not verify local storage. Sign-in and conversations remain closed to avoid loading an assumed empty workspace. Check site storage permissions, then reload; do not erase your data.
workspaceAdmission.lostBody: This window no longer has permission to open the data. Reload to run a new check. The URL and sign-in callback information are preserved.

workspaceWindow.loadFailedBody: Reload the page to try loading again. If you had opened your workspace, Arty will read the saved data again.
workspaceWindow.checkingBody: Checking that no other Arty window is changing this browser’s data.
workspaceWindow.busyBody: Another window or the PWA is using Arty in this browser profile. To protect your history, only one window can be active, including sign-in. Close the other window, then retry here. This window has not loaded or changed your workspace.
workspaceWindow.unsupportedBody: This browser does not provide the lock needed to protect your workspace. Update your browser or Android System WebView. Your data has not changed; public pages remain available.
workspaceWindow.failedBody: The browser did not allow this workspace reservation. Retry or check its storage restrictions. Your workspace has not been accessed.
workspaceWindow.lostBody: This window’s reservation is no longer valid. The workspace has been closed: reload the page to read the saved data again.

optionsSheet.title: This conversation

modelDesc.auto: Arty picks a model suited to your request and access
modelDesc.mistral: Data processed in Europe — private content, files, clients
modelDesc.openai: Manual or automatic selection depending on your request and access

optionsSheet.euNote: This conversation contains EU data (Mistral). Picking a 🇺🇸 model will ask for confirmation before sending its content outside Europe.
optionsSheet.euLocked: Europe-locked conversation — Mistral only, voice dictation included (Voxtral 🇫🇷) · fact-check disabled (it would leave Europe)

modelExplain.mistral: Mistral runs in Europe mode (servers in France) — ideal for private content supplied in chat, files and client information. No web search or link opening.
modelExplain.gemini: Gemini handles real-time web search, news questions and Google Maps queries. Data processed outside Europe.
modelExplain.haiku: Claude Haiku handles quick, short conversations — no monthly cap on paid plans (the free plan is limited to 10/day).
modelExplain.opus: Claude Opus handles deep analysis, complex tasks and multi-step reasoning. Pro model.
modelExplain.claude: Claude is the default for attached files, private content supplied in chat, URLs to open, or requests needing Drive and Calendar tools. Data is processed in the United States (Anthropic).
modelExplain.openai: GPT (OpenAI) is used when you select it manually — or automatically depending on your request and access. Data processed outside Europe.
modelExplain.fallback: Model picked automatically based on your request.

routeReason.eu_only: Europe-mode conversation: Mistral (servers in France) is the only model used — your data never leaves Europe.
routeReason.files_to_claude: The selected model cannot handle this file in Arty, so Claude is used to analyze it.
routeReason.office_documents: Word/Excel documents in this conversation are read locally, then analyzed by Claude.
routeReason.project_documents: Project context analysed by Claude in read-only mode, after an approved preview.
routeReason.files_mistral_native: Image attached with Mistral selected: Mistral analyzes it with its native vision (data stays in Europe).
routeReason.image_vision_openai: Compatible photos: GPT-5.6 Terra analyzes them in 4K detail through OpenAI.
routeReason.private_data: Your request contains private content supplied in chat, a file or calendar data, so Claude handles it without an unnecessary web search.
routeReason.youtube_native: YouTube link detected: Gemini watches the video directly.
routeReason.url_web_fetch: Link detected: Claude actually opens and reads the page (other models only see snippets and may make things up).
routeReason.trail_tools: Trails or GPX track: Claude queries OpenStreetMap (real marked routes) and can generate the GPX file.
routeReason.openai_intent: You mentioned ChatGPT/GPT: your request was sent to it.
routeReason.hybrid_research: Report or comparison: Gemini does the web research, then Claude writes the synthesis.
routeReason.trivial_chat: Short message: fast path, no unnecessary web search.
routeReason.default_capable: General question: Gemini answers with Google Search (up-to-date info).
routeReason.fallback_no_provider: The ideal model isn't available on this account: falling back to the best accessible one.
routeReason.plan_locked_haiku: Free or trial account without credits: Claude Haiku is the included model.
routeReason.submodel_haiku_trivial: Short message: Claude Haiku is enough (fast and light).
routeReason.submodel_opus_report: Strategic report: Claude Opus, the most powerful model, steps in.
routeReason.submodel_sonnet_default: Claude Sonnet, the best power/speed balance.
routeReason.server_model_substitution: The server applied the Claude model available for your account.

hero.lede: Arty brings Claude, GPT-5, Gemini and Mistral together in one personal assistant, with your Google calendar and the content you choose to share with it.
hero.googleData: After Google connection, Arty displays upcoming events from your primary calendar. It creates, updates or deletes an event only when you ask. The proactive brief, enabled by default for paid and VIP accounts and switchable off in Settings, may read your upcoming events and send Anthropic (Claude) the context needed to prepare the brief. This data is never used for advertising.

problem.title: How much are your AI subscriptions costing you?
problem.p1: ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Gemini… stacking them costs €60–80 a month, for opaque limits and three interfaces that don't talk to each other.
problem.p2: Arty replaces them with a single assistant: you pick the model for the task, you see your limits in plain words, and you pay a final price you know upfront.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: With the subscription: 150 Claude Sonnet/Opus messages and 100 GPT-5 per month, plus Haiku, Flash and Mistral with no monthly cap, subject to a daily anti-abuse limit. The free trial includes 30 messages with Claude Haiku, with no credit card required.
faq.q2: Can I use my own API key?
faq.a2: Yes. BYOK is free on Arty's side, with no required Pro licence. Standalone sign-in requires an Anthropic key; you can then add OpenAI, Google or Mistral keys and use compatible models. Providers bill you separately. Keys are stored locally without additional application-level encryption. They transit over HTTPS through Arty's proxy to the provider, without storage or logging on Arty's server.
faq.q3: What's the difference between the Subscription and Pro?
faq.a3: The Subscription (€9.99/mo VAT incl.) works without an API key: Arty provides model access, with quotas stated in plain words. Pro (€39 one-time) is an optional licence for app features. AI calls use your own keys and are billed by your providers; they are not included in the licence.
faq.q4: What happens when I reach my quota?
faq.a4: Nothing silent: Arty tells you and lets you choose — add a 100 premium messages pack (€1.99), continue on the models with no monthly cap, or wait for next month.
faq.a5: Conversations are kept locally with AES-256 encryption. This is not end-to-end encryption: requests transit through Arty's proxy to the selected providers. Europe mode uses Mistral for chat. See the privacy policy for data processing, automatic memory and the limitations of local encryption.
faq.q6: Does Arty replace ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro?
faq.a6: Arty is a personal assistant that brings several AIs into one app, with your calendar and your content. If you stack several subscriptions today, one may be enough — and if another model is stronger for your task, you switch in one tap without losing the thread.
faq.a7: Florent Pollet, solo founder, in France. When you write to support, he's the one who answers.

account.deleteDescription: Permanently erases your content, sessions, and reports — on this device and our servers.
account.confirmBody: This can't be undone. Your conversations, attachments, reports, sessions, memory, and settings will be deleted. Only any invoices (legal requirement) and minimal technical usage, quota, and anti-abuse counters are retained; they contain none of your conversation content.
account.readFailed: The local journal could not be read. Arty cannot determine whether a request was already sent.
account.authorizedCleanupBody: This local cleanup was already authorized. Arty finishes it without a new server request. This historical journal does not by itself prove remote deletion.
account.uncertain: The request may have completed. Checking only reads its receipt, without signing in or sending another deletion request. An unknown receipt does not prove failure; contact support if the outcome remains unknown.
account.legacyUnknown: This older request has no readable receipt. Arty cannot confirm its outcome or automatically send it again. Contact support or choose device-only erasure.
account.recoveryBody: Arty checks the existing receipt if needed, then finishes local cleanup only when server deletion is confirmed. No new server deletion is requested. Closing this screen does not cancel the original request.
account.error: Erasure is not fully confirmed. Check the existing receipt, finish previously authorized cleanup or contact support. Checking does not retry a server deletion that may have failed.
account.localRecovery: If server confirmation could not be saved, Arty cannot infer that the account was deleted. You may choose to erase this device only.
account.localDescription: Erase this profile’s data on this device only. No server deletion is requested.
account.localTitle: Erase only this account’s data on this device?
account.localBody: Irreversible: local conversations, projects, documents, keys and sessions will be erased. This also removes this device’s ability to check any pending remote request. This action neither requests nor confirms server deletion. Server data may remain; contact support to complete its erasure.

mailAccountsModal.subtitle: Read-only, straight from your phone.
mailAccountsModal.settingsDescription: Connect Free, Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud… read-only
mailAccountsModal.androidOnly: Mailbox connection is only available on the Android app: reading happens directly on your phone, nothing goes through our servers.
mailAccountsModal.hintFree: Use your Free mail password (the Zimbra webmail one).
mailAccountsModal.hintGmail: Requires an app password (16 letters): enable 2-step verification, then create one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Paste it as-is, spaces are ignored. Never your main Google password.
mailAccountsModal.hintYahoo: Requires an app password, created in your Yahoo account security settings.
mailAccountsModal.hintIcloud: Requires an app password, created at appleid.apple.com (Sign-In and Security).
mailAccountsModal.confirmRemove: Remove mailbox {{email}}? Its password will be deleted from this device.
mailAccountsModal.errorMissing: Fill in the server, address and password.
mailAccountsModal.errorAuth: Authentication refused. Check the address and app password.
mailAccountsModal.errorInvalidHost: Invalid server address. Check the IMAP server name.
mailAccountsModal.errorInvalidEmail: Invalid email address. Check for stray characters.
mailAccountsModal.errorInvalidPassword: Invalid password (forbidden character, pasted line break…). Type it again.
mailAccountsModal.errorConnect: Could not reach the server. Check the server name and your internet connection.
mailAccountsModal.errorTooMany: Limit of 5 mailboxes reached. Remove one to add another.
mailAccountsModal.errorGeneric: Could not add this mailbox right now.
mailAccountsModal.securityNote: Your password is encrypted with the Android Keystore and is never sent to our servers. Arty reads your mail in read-only mode: no sending, no deleting, no editing. When you ask Arty to read or summarise a message, its content is sent to our AI provider (Anthropic, United States) to answer you — never to any other model. Attachments are not read.
mailAccountsModal.consentLabel: I understand and agree that the content of the messages Arty reads is sent to Anthropic (Claude, United States) to answer my requests.
mailAccountsModal.errorConsent: Tick the box to confirm you understand before connecting a mailbox.
